title: RE60012: Performance Engineering For Sustainability
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Population pressure and finite Non-renewal Resources. Growing problems of
developed and developing economies. Carrying capacity of Earth. Environmental
perspective of development, Mining dumps, Disposal of Wastes, Pollution of free
open access resources, like water and air. Conventional Energy sources and
their implications of use. Renewal energy sources and biomass energy sources.
Energy conservation and efficiency improvement. Life Cycle costs, Absence of
Internalization of preservation costs. Performance perspective of development,
New pathways for sustainable development, concept of industrial ecology,
molecular manufacturing, efficient energy generation, energy efficient use,
cleaner transportation, cleanup biotechnology, improved materials, conservation
of resources and materials, recycling and reuse, waste minimization and
controlling emissions, energy management.
